{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
raw_data['revenue'] = raw_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = raw_data['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Remove QA orders
clean_data = raw_data[~qa_mask]

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_data = clean_data[
    (clean_data['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (clean_data['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Compute conversion rate
num_converted = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
num_total = len(filtered_data)
conversion_rate = num_converted / num_total

# Now, print the three numbers as individual outputs with no formatting
# Use float formatting to ensure precision is preserved
print(f'{num_converted}')
print(f'{num_total}')
print(f'{conversion_rate:.15f}')"}
